notes: PROPOSED 2026-08-31 from the FLOW-13 brief. Most notifications go straight to the flow that owns them and need no detail screen. This one exists for the handful that carry a DECISION — a booking request, a collaboration invitation — where accepting or declining from the list would be too easy to do by accident. It shows the context and hands off; it deliberately does not reproduce the booking page.

sample.title: Studio Booking Approved
sample.body: Your booking at Blue Room Mixing Suite, Mumbai on July 12, 14:00–18:00 has been confirmed.
